capabilities: Share a vault with friends via a self-hosted server (Docker, Caddy/nginx, or Node)
Sync changes between members automatically within seconds
Merge notes edited by two people line by line without losing content
Create and join shared vaults through invitation links
View member activity, set a profile photo and display name, and pause or run syncs
extras: Privacy caveats: the server host can read all shared content and there is no end-to-end encryption in version 0.1; the README warns to back up the vault before trying it and to keep .obsidian/ out of public repositories. Not yet installable from the official catalog pending review; BRAT or manual installation is required meanwhile. README is bilingual (English and French).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for a group of users to share and sync one vault on a server they control without a paid service or third-party account.

relations.evidence: when you enable it, Cordee contacts the Moodle site you enter

summary: Self-hosted vault sharing plugin that syncs a vault with friends on your own server and merges conflicting note edits line by line.
